beforeInterview.advice: Review branching and conflict resolution by creating two branches that edit the same line, then resolve and inspect the resulting commit. Prepare to explain when a merge is preferable to a rebase and how each changes history.

improvements.advice: If you have used Git, add a truthful example of your workflow. Otherwise practise a branch-and-merge exercise before discussing it in the interview.

strengths.advice: Prepare to explain one component and its automated unit tests from the work described. Discuss the state transitions you tested and one trade-off in component responsibilities without claiming features beyond that work.
